NCBI assemblies appear first, followed by GTDB, BV-BRC/PATRIC, IMG and AllTheBacteria genome records. Links retain evidence from BacDive, GTDB metadata, GOLD and StrainInfo; AllTheBacteria links preserve the BioSample evidence connecting the assembly to the strain. Supplied accession versions, source strain identifiers and database meanings are preserved. NCBI accessions without a version suffix have unspecified version. Links under one strain do not establish genome equivalence; source descriptions may identify a substrain or plasmid. Samples, GOLD organism/project records, StrainInfo strain/deposit records and nucleotide references are listed separately. StrainInfo sequences must explicitly name the matched source deposit.
